title: Ehrhart's sharp volume inequality
abstract: Proves Ehrhart's sharp upper bound for the volume of a centered full-dimensional convex body whose origin is its unique interior lattice point. The development builds the weighted complex-analytic and variational machinery needed for the bound and verifies sharpness using the centered simplex, including its barycenter and exact volume.

informal.Ehrhart.Volume.ehrhart_volume_inequality: In every positive dimension, a compact full-dimensional convex set with barycenter zero and origin as its unique interior lattice point has volume at most (n + 1)^n / n!.
informal.Ehrhart.SimplexVolume.normalizedVolume_c: The centered dilation of the standard n-simplex has normalized volume exactly (n + 1)^n / n!, so the volume bound is sharp.
informal.Ehrhart.SimplexVolume.barycenter_centere: The centered dilation of the standard simplex has barycenter zero.
informal.Ehrhart.SimplexVolume.exists_centeredBod: In every positive dimension there exists a centered convex body with a unique interior lattice point that attains the sharp volume bound.

classification.branch: convex geometry and geometry of numbers
